site.title: BenXinAdmin · A Production-Ready Open-Source Admin Foundation
site.description: An open-source admin foundation on ThinkPHP 8 + Vue 3 — code generator, RBAC with data scopes, pluggable storage, and common business modules. Apache-2.0, commercial-friendly.

hero.title: A production-ready admin foundation, open source
hero.subtitle: Auth, RBAC, a code generator, and common business modules out of the box. Build your product on top — stop reinventing the foundation.

why.title: Every admin project starts by rebuilding the same thing
why.body: Authentication, permissions, menus, dictionaries, logs, files, payments, messaging — the plumbing eats your timeline yet has nothing to do with your actual product. BenXinAdmin hardens all of it into one consistent, secure, runnable foundation, so you can focus on the business from day one.

features.title: One foundation, all the admin essentials

items.title: Code Generator
items.desc: Read a table schema and generate the backend quartet plus frontend list/form/assign dialogs — faithfully replicating the hand-written golden template, conventions and all.

items.title: RBAC + Data Scope
items.desc: Casbin-driven permissions down to the button level, plus five data-scope tiers: all / department / department-and-below / self / custom.

items.title: Dual-Guard Auth
items.desc: Separate guards and secrets for admin and client, dual-token JWT, with allow/deny lists backed by Valkey.

items.title: Pluggable Storage
items.desc: Route by media type across local / Aliyun OSS / Qiniu / Tencent VOD. Cloud is off by default — runs fully on local storage with zero config.

items.title: Business Building Blocks
items.desc: Content, payments, messaging, and WeChat are framework-level: encrypted secrets, a four-part callback-security pattern, and events that decouple your business logic.

items.title: Lazy Login for Clients
items.desc: One uni-app codebase ships Mini Program + H5, with lazy login, login-as-registration, and WeChat + phone flows across both.

moat.title: Golden template first. The generator replicates it.
moat.body: We don't chase a do-everything generator. We hand-write a golden template polished to the last detail, then make the generator replicate it character-for-character. The repo ships an anti-drift baseline and a fidelity-regression script — clone it and verify "generated == hand-written" in a single command. The moat proves itself.

security.title: Security as a baseline, not a tagline
security.body: Every module ships against one security checklist: parameterized ORM with zero string-built SQL, field allowlists against mass assignment, real-MIME + extension double-checks on upload, dedicated rate limits on sensitive endpoints, AES-encrypted third-party secrets, server-side rich-text sanitizing plus front-end escaping, log redaction, and full audit trails.

stack.title: A modern, stable, commercial-friendly stack
stack.caption: All open source and commercial-friendly, with zero AGPL contamination.

showcase.title: Admin and client, ready out of the box
